framings.text: I think this is about helping people read your blog comfortably at night, including through the Hamster RSS reader, with system-based appearance preference acceptable.

outcome: People can read the blog comfortably at night, both on the blog and through Hamster.

questions.text: Should the nighttime comfort appear within Hamster’s reading view as well as on the blog?

alternatives.label: PROVISIONAL: Manual dark appearance choice
alternatives.benefit: Readers can choose a darker presentation when needed.
alternatives.cost: Readers must find and use the choice.
alternatives.undo_cost: PROVISIONAL: removing it may leave some readers without a direct remedy.

alternatives.label: PROVISIONAL: Follow the system appearance setting
alternatives.benefit: The presentation can match a reader’s existing nighttime preference without another choice.
alternatives.cost: Readers whose system setting does not match their needs may receive no relief.
alternatives.undo_cost: PROVISIONAL: reverting may require restoring prior appearance behavior.
